description:
This spacious guest suite overlooks the historic Sycamore Valley in Ashland City, Tennessee. Enjoy a peaceful escape while only a 30 minute drive from all that Nashville has to offer.  This dedicated guest suite is located on the lower level of our home and boasts its own private entrance, patio with hot tub and stunning views in every season.  Located between Ashland City & Pleasant View there is convenient access to stores & restaurants.

The space
Close to everything, away from it all.  Enjoy the quiet countryside, yet have all the conveniences and entertainment of Nashville only 30 minutes away.  Clarksville is approximately 30 minutes away and the Nashville International Airport (BNA) is 40 minutes away. Of course these times are estimates dependent on traffic conditions. 

Everyday we are thankful for the post card view we enjoy. My husband Todd and I live on the upper level of the house with our French Bulldog, Indy. We recently built out the lower level of our house to welcome guests. We took much care to insulate between the floors so that we would not share noise. 

The upper and lower levels are completely separate and private including private entrances. The deck above is our outdoor space and the patio below, including the hot tub is private outdoor space for our guests. 

We enjoy meeting people but we will not make any attempt to interact with you. If you would like meet, just let us know.  With that being said, you may see us in the driveway or working in the yard or gardens. 

This is a two bedroom Guest Suite with a king bed in one bedroom and a queen in the other bedroom. Each bed will comfortably sleep two people each.  Additionally, a queen sized air mattress, complete with bedding, is also available for an additional two people.

A great stay begins with great communication. Please take a moment to make yourself and everyone staying with you aware of the following information and rules.

We have a Ring doorbell that has a camera. It is angled away from the hot tub. There is also an exterior camera on the front of the house overlooking the driveway / parking area. Cameras are not to be covered or disabled. 

We require that all adult guests be listed on the reservation and have identity verification completed on Airbnb before arrival. Please do this early since it can sometimes take awhile.  We also have a welcome board and would like to include everyone who is staying, so please message us with the first names of children and pets who will be staying. 

The minimum age to book a stay is 21 years old. 

These rules are the most strictly enforced:  
Absolutely NO use of cannabis or any illegal drugs on the property.  
No smoking or vaping inside the guest suite. You are permitted to smoke or vape outside in designated areas.
Beware that if you smoke anything inside, you will be charged an additional $250. cleaning fee. 

Parties:
Even though Nashville currently seems to be the bachelorette party capital, we will not host bachelor or bachelorette parties or any party that centers around loud and drunken behavior. 

We do welcome our guests to celebrate birthdays and anniversaries, etc. Generally we only expect those listed on the reservation to be in attendance for your celebration. However, let us know if you are visiting friends or family in the area and would like to have them over for awhile. 

Generally we do not allow any open flames including candles but, if you are celebrating a birthday you are welcome to use birthday cake candles. 

Quiet Hours are between 10 p.m and 8 a.m.  You are welcome to use the patio and hot tub during these hours, we just ask that you do not play loud music or talk / laugh loudly.  

Our beautiful view is due to the fact that the house is located on a ridge overlooking a valley. You can expect steep and uneven ground if you move beyond the patio and level yard area around the patio. Proceed with caution and at your own risk.   Additionally, there are outside stairs leading to the Guest Suite.  Please consider this if you have difficulty navigating stairs. 

During mild weather it is a temptation to leave the doors open. However, bugs, lizards and small animals may come inside if you leave the doors open.  Please keep the doors closed to keep these pests and critters outside.  Thanks!

Hot Tub Rules:
We work hard to provide an exceptionally clean and balanced hot tub for your use. It is cleaned and prepared prior to each guest stay. We think you will love relaxing in it as you enjoy the view. There is a more extensive listing of hot tub rules in the guest suite but these are the essentials:
~Please shower to remove lotions and oils from your body and hair before entering the tub.
~Do not add any oils or soaps to the hot tub water. 
~No glass.  You will find plastic drink ware in the kitchen for your use. 
~Close the cover when not in use.  
~If the hot tub is misused, there will be an additional $250. cleaning fee charged. 

Dog guests: 
  ~We welcome one small dog. 
  ~Please list the dog on your reservation. An additional $50. cleaning fee will be charged.
  -Dogs must be kenneled when you are not present. We can provide a kennel for a small dog. 
  ~ Please do not allow your dog on the beds. 
  ~A potty clean up container is provided for your use. 
  ~No cats or other types of pets are allowed. 

Thank you for helping us to provide a safe and clean place for all our guests.  

We are here to help you plan for your special occasions or to simply have a fun vacation.  Please let us know if we can receive grocery orders prior to your arrival, or pick up a birthday cake and balloons. 

Be sure to check out our Guidebook on the listing. There is also a printed copy in the Home Manual on the entryway table in Guest Suite.

You are going to have a great time!

Guest access
Parking is available in the driveway in front of the “Guest Parking” sign. We can accommodate 2 vehicles. Walk down the sidewalk between the house and garage continuing down the steps to the lower level. Enter the Guest Suite through the doors beside the hot tub. 

There is a Wi-Fi connected keypad for entry. You will receive a code 24 - 48 hours prior to check-in.

Other things to note
The ridge is also filled with wildlife. In their seasons you may enjoy seeing hummingbirds, butterflies, birds, bunnies and squirrels.  Occasionally we have had deer and wild turkeys walking through the yard. You may also see hawks and eagles soaring over the valley.

If your dog is joining you, please keep them on a leash at all times. Although rare, we have seen coyotes, fox and other animals that could be a threat to your dog.  

Please feel free to walk through the gardens. Take a seat in the pollinator garden to enjoy the bees and butterflies durning the spring, summer and fall.

A Brief but Ridiculous History… 

If you’ve spent any time in Pleasant View, you’ve probably heard the whispers. The ones that surface over late-night drinks or at the corner of a bonfire conversation—about a stretch of land where planes used to drop low over the trees, and things came and went that weren’t exactly welcome on Main Street.

In the early ’80s, this cabin and the land surrounding it weren’t just off the beaten path—they were off the radar. An old airstrip once cut through these fields, and stories still circulate about a plane that made regular trips from who-knows-where into the outskirts of Nashville. The cargo? No one asks too many questions. But it’s said it didn’t stay above ground for long. A tunnel—hidden, hand-dug, and hush-hush—ran straight into the hill and swallowed it whole.

That tunnel still exists. These days, it’s been reborn as a speakeasy. You can grab a drink there. Play a song. Tell a secret. But if you listen closely, you might hear stories of a second tunnel—wider, deeper, and sealed off long ago after the law caught on. 

Today, Sugar Hill plays a different tune. It’s a refuge for the restless—a place for musicians, dreamers, rebels, and families alike. We don’t traffic in anything illicit anymore. But we kept the spirit. The grit. The sense that you don’t have to play by anyone’s rules but your own.

Step inside after a day on the water and let the warmth work into your shoulders. The indoor infrared sauna fits two comfortably and runs differently than a traditional sauna — a deep, radiant warmth that doesn't feel overwhelming, even for first-timers. Chromotherapy lighting lets you set the mood. In summer it's the perfect wind-down. In fall and winter, it's the reason guests start planning a return trip before they've even left.

From nearly every corner of the house, large glass windows frame sweeping, unobstructed views of Old Hickory Lake. Sunlight glints off the water, birds drift lazily by, and breezes roll through the trees with a calming hush. The sound of water lapping gently at the shore sets the pace for your days here: slow, serene and soulfully quiet. 

Step into the “magic” verandah, a stunning back porch where the boundary between inside and outside dissolves. Automatic screens drop at the touch of a button and a massive triple glass door disappears into the wall. Suddenly the spacious living room doubles in size and spills into nature. You’ll feel the warm lake air wrap around you as you enjoy your morning coffee or your evening wine, watching wildlife move through the water, just feet away. 

Upstairs, a second-story screened porch enhances the experience even further. Is it inside? Is it outside? The answer is both. A sleek glass garage door separates the space from the home, and when lifted, it turns the porch into an airy extension of the home. It’s a place to read with the breeze on your skin or nap in a hammock while ospreys dive for fish only a few feet away. 

Every detail of the home invites exploration and joy. One bedroom hides a whimsical secret room — a surprise awaiting curious, inquisitive guests. On a bookshelf in a different part of the house, figure out which book to gently push, and you discover a whole new floor of the house! 

The game room pulses with energy, featuring a tournament-grade foosball table and pop-a-shot basketball that bring out everyone’s competitive side. 

Out back, the private dock is perfect for early morning kayak launches or tying up your boat after a day on the water. And for those who prefer wildlife watching to water sports, simply sit still. River otters frolic onshore and nest right at the lakeshore, while beautiful white pelicans with 10 foot wingspans soar past during fall through spring. Great blue herons and white cranes stalk the shoreline while cormorants dive beneath the surface reappearing triumphantly with glittering fish. You might spot baby foxes playing on the rocks, turtles sunning on a log, or even Bald Eagles circling above. 

Whether you’re roasting marshmallows under the stars or preparing a lakeside feast, the estate’s outdoor fire pit and grill make it easy to savor meals in the open air while soaking up the natural beauty that surrounds you. In the evenings, as the sky turns to peach and lavender, gather on the verandah and listen: the gentle call of frogs, the fluttering wings and the laughter of loved ones. 

There is magic in the stillness. In the light. In the lake. 

Whether you’re planning a family reunion, a creative retreat, or a relaxing escape from the rush of daily life, The Estate on Old Hickory Lake offers an unforgettable sensory journey — one where every sunrise feels like a painting and every nightfall feels like a satisfying sigh.

The whole immersive system is founded on two large base woofers that literally make explosions rock the room. 

Wildlife lovers think they are in heaven at this Estate. The majestic American White Pelican migrates through here for months twice a year. River otters play in the backyard and have a den at the waters edge on this property. Baby foxes frolic in the rock garden. If you hang out on the back porch for a while you can see Ospreys diving for fish into the lake right in front of you. Great Blue Herons and White Cranes hunt on the shore constantly. There is a marina with full service restaurant and rental boats 3.5 miles or 7 minutes away.

The space
This newly renovated home features 4 bedrooms and 2 full baths and TWO living areas! Spread out, or cozy up! This home is great for families and friends to enjoy their time together.  At "home" feel free to decompress in the hot tub on the patio!  Please shower before entering the hot tub especially if you are returning from the lake.* There are both a gas and charcoal grill available for your use. 

Inside, there are smart TV's in both living rooms and all of the bedrooms.  You can log on to your subscription services.  But if you're looking for a more interactive experience, we have a collection of board games for you to play! 

The home is a split level layout.  You will enter through the side door at the lower level consisting of the living room with the brown leather couch, bunk room, and laundry room. Up a short set of stairs is the kitchen, dining room, living room with the gray sectional, and the full bath with shower.  There are just a few more steps from there to the area with the other 3 bedrooms and full bath with tub. 

Perfect for kayakers and canoers, you can slip your boats in to the cove and enjoy direct access to the lake.  We have a canoe you may use with 2 provided life vests and oars (in the shed), but we ask you not to use them on your personal boats as they tend to disappear.*  For larger boats, there are 3 launch points within 5 minutes. The middle of the cove is a bit shallow for larger boats, so do stay to the side as you navigate to and from the property. The cove depth ranges from 2-5' deep depending on where you are navigating and water level.  Pontoons shouldn't have any trouble, but deeper set boats cruise in with more caution. The level of the lake can be very changeable and is unpredictable. We don't have a way to forecast the depth at any given time. Please feel free to reach out with questions!
*see additional info below for all the nearby access areas*  

Looking to fish?  The shore is Corp of Engineers property and therefore has "public" access and you can utilize the shoreline to get the best bites! Because we are at the back of the cove, there are rarely other fisherpersons around so it remains quite private. Please note a fishing license is required to fish in TN. Daily licenses are available. Get one from GoOutdoorsTennessee dot org.

-Cedar Creek Marina has a ship store, boat rentals, ramp, and a restaurant; Scoreboards Bar & Grill. If you prefer to dock there, you can rent a slip. The transient dock rental through them directly is $50/day at last check.

-Cedar Creek Recreation Area has a swim area, picnic tables, sand volleyball court, and boat ramp. They also have pontoon, yacht and kayak rentals.  The recreation area asks $5 to park, $2 to walk in, or if you will be using it a lot, $40 for an annual pass.

-Shutes Branch Recreation Area also has picnic sites, swimming areas, boat launch, and fishing platform.  There is also a biking trail that progressively gets more challenging.  Pets are allowed.

-Blue Turtle Bay is another marina a short 15 minutes away with pontoon boat rentals, and Sam's Sports Grill.

*See house rules for full details.

Guest access
The whole property is available for you to enjoy! Please use proper water safety!  If additional parking is needed, you can pull through the end of the driveway to park in the grass beyond it. Please do not park on the road if at all possible.

Aptly named ‘Mountain Music’ as it features simply stunning panoramic vistas of the Nashville countryside and is quite frankly the perfect place for a get-away or retreat to write music, enjoy family bonding, marvel in God’s nature and yet commute in and out of Nashville in 30 minutes!

New for 2024 includes new flooring throughout the home, a brand new Fire-Pit set on a concrete pad with Adirondack chairs and a 6 person HOT TUB to enjoy the views!

The space
Equipped with a guitar and ukele (please treat with care), incredible kitchen renovation, expansive back deck with grill, fire pit and hot tub (new in 2024) overlooking the valley, 2 hammocks to attach to the trees out back and a front porch to sit and stare at quite amazing sunsets…

This 3 bedroom home features 1 king bed and 2 queen beds along with 2 full bathrooms. Luxury sheets, comforters, pillows & towels are provided. There are additionally 2 full size sleeper sofas in the living room that comfortably sleep 2 additional guests (supplementary bedding and pillows are provided). If you are planning a lengthy stay, we have a washer and dryer to take care of your laundry needs. In 2024 we replaced all of the flooring to elevate the feel of the property even further. We've also added a new charcoal grill to sizzle up some steaks!

With this being an elevated property that sits right at the top of a hill, please be aware that there is a steep gravel driveway. Winters in Nashville are generally mild, but on a rare occasion we get snow and ice and there is always a possibility you may feel more comfortable parking at the bottom of the driveway and walking up if the ice is severe. That being said, as it is a gravel driveway, there is usually no need for this (mentioned purely for practical purposes and to recommend purchasing travel insurance incase of inclement weather).

The fire pit is in the center of a newly poured circular concrete area with Adirondack seating around it.  We have some additional seats stored in the lower storage shed should you need it. We supply firewood for each group and Home Depot and Lowes both sell pre-bundled packs and are nearby if you need additional. Please don’t overload the fire as summers can be hot and dry.

This is a no-smoking property. Please refrain from smoking in the home otherwise your security deposit will be immediately forfeited.

The TV comes with an Xfinity channel package including several sports channels such as ESPN and NBCSN etc. 

Wireless internet is also available at no charge. The login info will be provided at the cottage.

This home is truly one for making memories. We hope you decide to make this your home away from home while you vacation in Nashville.

You will have access to everything advertised.

In addition to sending a message through the app, please try to reach us via cellphone and text message if you need something urgently.

Guest access
You will have access to everything advertised.

Other things to note
This home is pet friendly to dogs only with a two pet maximum. Please make sure you select your pets at the time of booking as a $150 fee is collected for reservations including animals. We do also follow breed and weight restrictions please reach out to us directly for more information!

This home is a short 25 minutes from Nashville, but far enough for that get away, country feel. This air-conditioned house is also located in the popular 2-foot cove on Old Hickory Lake.  Check out Dolly Parton’s vacation home as you kayak through the cove.

The space
This home features 3 newly furnished bedrooms and 2 ½ baths. The home also has a second living room that could be used as an additional bedroom with the pull out couch, or as a community area for fun, games, music, and relaxation.  There is a fully stocked kitchen, and a washer and drier available for your convenience. If you have a little one, we even have a high chair and pack-n-play crib available. The home has plenty of space and amenities for everyone!

We hope that you will make lifetime memories enjoying family, friends, and your pets, during your stay! 

Enjoy evenings barbecuing on the deck. Relax by the firepit roasting hot dogs and  marshmallows, or catching fireflies during the summer!  

This home is only 25 minutes to downtown Nashville and 15 minutes from the airport. Great home for families and friends to meet up, enjoy the water, and start sightseeing adventures in and around Nashville.

We have put together a detailed guide with local activities, restaurants and attractions in the area that we think you will enjoy.

Inside, there are smart TV's in the living room, game room, and master bedroom. You can utilize the available TV programming, or log on to your own subscription services. 

Bedroom 1: King Bed | Bedroom 2: Queen Bed | Bedroom 3: Full Bunk Bed with Twin Trundle Bed | Game Room/Second living room: Queen Sleeper Sofa

Most of the home is on the main level where you enter through the front door. Rooms on the lower level are the second living room/game room, one of the full baths, and the laundry area.  These can be accessed from outside if steps are an issue for one of your guests, but will need to be unlocked from inside. 

We have entertainment available inside and outside.  Enjoy the many inside board games, a Pac-Man arcade game, poker table with poker chips, and a ping pong table. Outside we have Smash Ball, horseshoes, Corn hole, a golf net (you will need your own clubs), a kayak, paddle board, and fishing poles.  Feel free to use the easy up, beach chairs and small dock for jet skis.

Perfect for kayakers and canoers, you can slip your boats in to the cove and enjoy direct access to the lake.  For larger boats you will need to put in at one of the 3 launch points within 5 minutes of the home. The middle of the cove is a bit shallow for larger boats, so do stay to the side as you navigate to and from the property. The cove depth generally ranges from 2-5' deep depending on where you are navigating and the height of the water as this can vary due to rain fall and other factors. 

*see additional info below for all the nearby access areas*  

-Cedar Creek Marina has a ship store, boat rentals, ramp, dock rental, and a restaurant; Scoreboards Bar & Grill. 

-Cedar Creek Recreation Area has a swim area, picnic tables, sand volleyball court, and boat ramp. They also have pontoon, yacht and kayak rentals.  The recreation area asks $5 to park, $2 to walk in, or if you will be using it a lot, $40 for an annual pass.

-Shutes Branch Recreation Area also has picnic sites, swimming areas, boat launch, and fishing platform.  There is also a biking trail that progressively gets more challenging.  Pets are allowed.

-Blue Turtle Bay is another marina a short 15 minutes away with pontoon boat rentals, and Sam's Sports Grill.

Guest access
You will have access to the entire property! The jet skis in the garage are the only thing "off limits." 
Please use proper water safety.  There is a large yard between the house and water, so you have some space to relax* while your children play close to the home, but still have easy access to the water. 
*There is unrestricted access to the water, so children and pets should always be monitored outdoors.
